title: Joshua to Succeed Moses

questions.question: How old was Moses when he spoke these words?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:2 (ESV): "...I am 120 years old today. I am no longer able to go out and come in..."

questions.question: Who did Moses say would cross over before the people?
options: The Lord your God and Joshua
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord your God and Joshua
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:3 (ESV): "The Lord your God himself will go over before you... Joshua will go over at your head..."

questions.question: Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or be in dread of them, for who goes with you?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:6 (ESV): "Be strong and courageous. Do not fear... for it is the Lord your God who goes with you."

questions.question: To whom did Moses deliver the law?
options: The priests, the sons of Levi, and all the elders
questions.correctAnswer: The priests, the sons of Levi, and all the elders
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:9 (ESV): "Then Moses wrote this law and gave it to the priests... and to all the elders of Israel."

questions.question: How often was the law to be read before all Israel?
options: Every seven years, at the Feast of Booths
questions.correctAnswer: Every seven years, at the Feast of Booths
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:10–11 (ESV): "At the end of every seven years... at the Feast of Booths... you shall read this law..."

questions.question: What did God tell Moses he was about to do?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:16 (ESV): "Behold, you are about to lie down with your fathers..."

questions.question: What will the people do after they enter the land?
options: Rise and whore after the foreign gods
questions.correctAnswer: Rise and whore after the foreign gods
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:16 (ESV): "then this people will rise and whore after the foreign gods among them..."

questions.question: What will God do in response to their idolatry?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:17 (ESV): "Then my anger will be kindled... and I will forsake them and hide my face from them..."

questions.question: What was Moses commanded to write as a witness?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:19 (ESV): "Now therefore write this song and teach it to the people of Israel..."

questions.question: Where was the Book of the Law placed?
options: By the side of the ark of the covenant
questions.correctAnswer: By the side of the ark of the covenant
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:26 (ESV): "Take this Book of the Law and put it by the side of the ark of the covenant..."

questions.question: Who appeared in the tent of meeting in a pillar of cloud?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:15 (ESV): "And the Lord appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud..."

questions.question: Why teach the song?
options: That this song may be a witness for Me against the people
questions.correctAnswer: That this song may be a witness for Me against the people
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:19 (ESV): "...that this song may be a witness for me against the people of Israel."

questions.question: Moses knew what about the people's behavior after his death?
options: They would become utterly corrupt and turn aside
questions.correctAnswer: They would become utterly corrupt and turn aside
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:29 (ESV): "For I know that after my death you will surely act corruptly and turn aside from the way..."

questions.question: Who was commissioned in the tent of meeting?
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:23 (ESV): "And the Lord commissioned Joshua the son of Nun and said, 'Be strong and courageous...'"

questions.question: The song will confront them as a witness because of what quality?
options: It will live unforgotten in the mouths of their offspring
questions.correctAnswer: It will live unforgotten in the mouths of their offspring
questions.explanation: Deuteronomy 31:21 (ESV): "...for it will live unforgotten in the mouths of their offspring..."

key_verse_text: Be strong and courageous. Do not fear or be in dread of them, for it is the LORD your God who goes with you. He will not leave you or forsake you. (ESV)
